findings.title: B-SC-04 / A1-SC-01 only partially repaired — remedy partition still unnamed; major safety invariants still missing
findings.detail: TO-9 claims a total semantic remedy partition without binding the six CI-distinct classes. Envelope parity, pre-admission constructibility, orphan recovery, exit0≠attestation, tombstone expiry, and baseline no-mass-net-new remain absent from invariants. An implementation can still satisfy TO-1..11 with a coarse failure model and no orphan/baseline safety. Author resolves claims B-SC-04 ACCEPTED as if fully restored — overclaim.
findings.requiredFix: Add TO-12+ naming the six classes and their non-collapsible meanings; restore missing safety invariants with falsifiedBy; or rehome each to a referenced sealed claim with CE. Do not mark B-SC-04 closed until independent inventory is empty.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A trace mapping every v1.5 invariant to a TO id or rehomed claim.

findings.title: EC-1 still defines lifetime neutrality by surface form
findings.detail: falsifiedBy is 'any parameter/field/environment that branches on host lifetime'. A surface can omit isResident while semantics still depend on warm caches, resident providers, or publication paths (prior R1 findings). Retention of EC-3 helps but does not replace semantic re-entrancy.
findings.requiredFix: Rewrite EC-1: under identical Plan/Snapshot/exact Coverage, cold and resident hosts yield identical EvidenceDigest and evaluation outcomes; falsifiedBy any observable semantic difference. Surface flags are neither necessary nor sufficient.

findings.title: Disposition table is anti-laundering but not yet altitude-classified
findings.detail: DEFAULT STILL-OPEN is the correct failure mode for incomplete adjudication. 83 boilerplate opens do not discharge B-SC-08's requireChange to classify retained architectural vs detailed-design vs rehomed. Only 4 PROMOTED and 2 ADDRESSED-IN-DEMOTED. Architectural open items (A1-R1V13-01..03, B-R1V12-02..) should map to EC invariants or explicit still-open architecture blockers on R-1.
findings.requiredFix: Add disposition enum: STILL-OPEN-ARCH | STILL-OPEN-DETAIL | PROMOTED-TO-INVARIANT | ADDRESSED-IN-DEMOTED | SUPERSEDED | REHOMED(claim). Batch-classify by prefix rules with review, not 83 identical sentences.

findings.title: No mandatory design handoff for TO/EC counterexamples
findings.detail: falsifiedBy is good documentation. Without a handoff clause, a future d9-exit-contract.v2 can green-check field schemas while implementing a falsifying behavior. retention-tiers.v4 + A1-RTV4-01 is the pattern.
findings.requiredFix: detailedDesignHandoff: any production termination or core contract is incomplete until executable tests exist that attempt each TO/EC falsifiedBy and fail. Second author preferred for those tests. Demoted v1.5 runner is not that suite while A1-D9-V15C holes remain.
